description: Latest SEC filings for a company (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K with item numbers, S-1, DEF 14A, 4, 13D/G...), newest first, with filing date, report period, description and direct document URL. Filter by form types and a date range.

forms.description: Only these form types, e.g. ["10-K","10-Q","8-K"]. Amendments (/A) are included.

since.description: Only filings on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

ticker_or_cik.description: Stock ticker (e.g. "AAPL", "BRK.B") or SEC CIK number (e.g. "320193").

until.description: Only filings on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: get_company_filings
title: Company SEC filings list
